dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Another Lantern Rite is upon us.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Traveler, it seems Liyue has a way of drawing you back every once in a while. Do you miss it here?

choices.text: I miss it all the time.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Is that so? I am delighted to hear it.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Times change. Suddenly, the Lantern Rite of today is a wholly different affair from the past.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The preparations were very lengthy this time. I don't know if it is to everyone's tastes, but I, for one, am most satisfied with the way it has turned out.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I hope that it might be a highlight of your journey. If you ever grow weary in your travels, know that you can always come back and visit Liyue.

choices.text: My focus is on my mission, my journey.
